claimChanges.claimText: AI-ToolLab Transcription (Whisper-WebUI) is listed for Goethe-University Frankfurt am Main in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.

AI-ToolLab LLM API is listed for Goethe-University Frankfurt am Main in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.

AI-ToolLab Chatbot (LobeChat) is listed for Goethe-University Frankfurt am Main in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.

Goethe University Frankfurt's student-facing Lehre virtuell guidance says students who intend to use AI in an examination context must discuss what is allowed with their instructors and should assume no explicit permission is equivalent to a prohibition.

Goethe University Frankfurt's teacher-facing assessment guidance recommends defining clear rules for AI use, making AI use transparent, and using AI detection software only as supporting evidence rather than as the sole basis for proof.
Goethe University Frankfurt's general Lehre virtuell guidance tells users not to enter personal or sensitive information when using AI tools.

Goethe University Frankfurt has an official Generative AI working group that serves as a central contact point and provides handouts, tool access information, and a Community of Practice for generative AI in study and teaching.

Goethe University Frankfurt's general Lehre virtuell guidance states that the university generally supports testing and applying generative AI in study and teaching, while noting ethical, legal, and didactic considerations.
